selection: Maximize the minimum opponent mean coin margin, then overall mean margin, then name; select before any validation games.
promotion: Positive mean margin and at least 60 percent wins against lean20 and Euler28, no crashes or timeouts, zero losses against official starter; preserve every loss. Failure retains lean20 as the recommendation.
retuning: No candidate tuning on validation. Any later hypothesis requires a separate study and new validation seeds.
